GOLDEN PROMPT

Native tool protocol: use the exact schema supplied by this CLI. Never send an empty tool input. After a schema error, correct the missing fields before trying again; do not repeat the same invalid call. Use only permitted read-only tools: read(filePath), glob(pattern), grep(pattern) to inspect target files and prior actual test evidence. exec, exec_command, execute, bash, write and edit are unavailable in this read-only role; never call them or request shell/write permissions. For planning, use the supplied browser command/schema contract without reading the platform implementation.

GOLDEN PROMPT

Native tool protocol: use the exact schema supplied by this CLI. Never send an empty tool input. After a schema error, correct the missing fields before trying again; do not repeat the same invalid call. Use bash with command (string) and description (string) for shell commands, never exec or exec_command. The write tool is disabled in this attempt after observed schema failures; Kilo also excludes its shared native edit group. Do not call write/edit or invent content for a failed empty call. Use permitted bash commands with small, safely quoted heredocs to create or update files; preserve frozen acceptance files. Preserve existing tests and use bash to run them before deciding whether additional coverage is necessary. The tool shell is Windows PowerShell: use npm.cmd and npx.cmd to avoid npm.ps1 execution policy errors, or invoke node.exe directly. Use PowerShell syntax, not Bash for/do/done loops or &&. Do not change the host execution policy.
